implementation_summary: Reviewed the BE-101 SSRF path, BE-102 route access and dispatch, BE-600/601 audit store, BE-507 PDF/ZIP/renderers, AI key and prompt paths, and the wizard audit screens. No blockers. One major SSRF outside the diff: checkLink still uses Playwright APIRequestContext, which bypasses the beta request guard and DNS pinning. Four minor hardening gaps. Secret scan: no hits in changed files. pnpm audit --prod: clean.

tests_executed.name: secret scan
tests_executed.output_excerpt: Scanned 6750 text file(s): 180 potential secret(s) (2 high); all in untracked .env*, generated .qa-runner-report/.tmp-*, worktrees, or test fixtures; none in changed source

findings.title: Link checks use Playwright APIRequestContext, which bypasses the beta SSRF guard and DNS pinning
findings.recommendation: On RUNNER_BETA=1, a crawled site's off-site link (nav.to, expand.ts:177) to a private address, or a redirect or DNS rebind to one, is requested from Node without the context.route guard or the --host-resolver-rules pinning, and the status or error is shown in the report (blind SSRF with a status oracle). Send checkLink through makeOutboundFetch (pinned, every hop re-checked, guard-aware), as BE-101 did for contextFetcher.

findings.title: DEC-004 implemented as 'no key = every caller is owner', not 'local request = owner'
findings.recommendation: Safety rests only on cli.ts refusing a non-loopback bind. A user's own tunnel to localhost, or an embedder of RunnerServer, makes remote callers the owner. When no access key is set, also require a loopback req.socket.remoteAddress in carriesAccessKey/authorizeRoute.

findings.title: PDF Chromium launched with --no-sandbox while printing untrusted page text and AI output
findings.recommendation: JS off, offline mode and data:-only requests reduce the risk, but a renderer bug would not be contained. Keep the Chromium sandbox where the platform allows it, or isolate printing in a low-privilege process.

findings.title: Shared Link HTML (preview.html) will be served on the runner origin that holds the access cookie
findings.recommendation: When /s/:linkId is built, serve stored HTML with 'Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'' and nosniff (or from a separate origin) so stored page or AI text can't script against /api with the owner's cookie.

findings.title: Encrypted key fallback: legacy plaintext may persist, and an undecryptable file is overwritten
findings.recommendation: Tell users to rotate keys once a plaintext .qa-keys.json is migrated (OneDrive or backups may keep old copies). Refuse to overwrite a file that can't be decrypted (wrong or missing QA_KEYS_ENCRYPTION_KEY) instead of silently dropping its other keys.

findings.title: Route dispatch: exact matching, validated params, closed by default; unmatched paths still gated
findings.recommendation: Add a test asserting that every allRoutes row declares access and beta, and that 'public' rows stay limited to /s/:linkId.

findings.title: isPublicAddress treats 192.0.0.0/24 and 198.18.0.0/15 as public (not changed by this workflow)
findings.recommendation: Consider classifying the IETF special-purpose and benchmarking ranges as non-public.

findings.title: Helper grants store the plaintext email address (third-party personal data, ADR 0036)
findings.recommendation: Make sure retention and deleteAudit cover grant.json, and keep emails out of logs.

findings.title: resolveShare returns the full AuditSummary for the public route
findings.recommendation: The future /s/:linkId handler must render only the shared snapshot and never serialize the summary to the client.

findings.title: Gemini API key is put in the request URL (not changed by this workflow)
findings.recommendation: Use the x-goog-api-key header so the key can't appear in proxy logs or error URLs.

findings.title: No XSS sinks in the wizard audit screens; HTML/DOCX/ZIP outputs escaped or sanitized
findings.recommendation: Keep img src limited to the base64 data-URI check in isEmbeddableImage.

risks: RISK-001 (ADR 0031) is not fully closed: orchestrator checkLink still makes page-derived requests outside makeOutboundFetch.
Hosted beta security depends on RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN being set (deploy.yml:131 does set it) and the browser guard being installed at server start.
handoff: Fix checkLink (major) before release. Open follow-up tasks for: the loopback check in DEC-004, the PDF sandbox, sandbox headers on the future /s/ route, and the key-file overwrite.
